object.attr: analysis: resolving rewrites each file both sides changed from the commits (MELLON-VER-SRS-309), so an edit made after the merge stopped is lost without a warning (open question Q4, F1). Answered on 2026-11-11 (Q4 as recommended, with review Q2's change), to confirm: once no document file conflicts, edits that fix the merge are allowed. Test with the Document Editor kept active and with an MCP write (CF-V57).
object.description: While a document folder holds a conflicting file, Mellon shall refuse each operation that changes a file in a document folder, other than resolving the merge.
